brand.name: EgyKode
brand.tagline: Learn it. Build it. Ship it.
brand.promise: Every roadmap ends with a deployable production project.
brand.philosophy: Learn by building. Build by operating. Prove it in production.
brand.descriptor: The open Cloud & DevOps platform — learn, practise, deploy.
home.heroTitle: Learn Cloud & DevOps by building one real production platform.
home.heroBody: Not forty disconnected tutorials. One system — provisioned with Terraform, configured with Ansible, running on a self-managed Kubernetes cluster, delivered by GitOps, and observed end to end. You build it, phase by phase.
home.pathBody: Ten phases, from a Linux shell to a platform you can deploy and operate.
home.why1Body: Every chapter references the same production architecture — real Terraform modules, real Ansible roles, real pipelines. The project is the curriculum.
home.why2Body: Every topic covers what it is, how it works, commands you can run, how it fails in production, and the trade-off against the alternative. Audited, not asserted.
home.why3Body: MIT for the code, CC BY-SA for the content. No paywall, no ads. Built to be contributed to.

prepare.title: Prepare
prepare.intent: Everything for the week before an interview, and the hour after a deploy goes wrong.
prepare.interviewBody: Questions levelled junior to staff, each with a 30-second answer, a full answer, and the follow-up the interviewer asks next.
prepare.troubleshootBody: Symptom-first, not tool-first. Paste the error you actually got and get the diagnostic commands in order.
prepare.quizBody: Spaced repetition over what you have read, so it is still there in three months.
prepare.cheatsheetBody: kubectl, terraform, docker, helm, git — the flags that matter, with real output.
community.title: Community
community.intent: The people are the compounding part. This opens once the content is worth gathering around.
community.feedBody: Scoped to Cloud and DevOps practice. Unanswered questions surface first — an unreplied feed is a dead feed.
community.chatBody: Domain rooms and small private groups built around a path or a lab.
community.contributeBody: Fix a typo, translate a chapter, write a lab. Translation is the highest-value path and the lowest barrier.
community.profileBody: Skills shown only when the evidence exists: chapter read, quiz passed, lab completed.
jobs.title: Jobs
jobs.intent: Cloud, DevOps, SRE and Platform roles — matched against what you have actually proven.
jobs.boardBody: Egypt and MENA first, remote everywhere. Salary range required, or the listing is labelled and ranks lower.
jobs.matchBody: Your verified skills against the role's requirements, with the gaps linked back to the chapters that close them.
jobs.alertsBody: Alerts by email or push when something matching appears.
jobs.employerBody: Free to post. Every first listing is reviewed by a human before it appears.
roadmap.privacyNote: Progress is stored in this browser only. Sign-in sync is coming with accounts.
courses.title: Courses
courses.intent: Guided video paths over the same chapters — for when reading is not how you want to start.
courses.videoBody: Hosted on YouTube and embedded behind a click-to-load facade. Self-hosting video is the fastest way to a bill, and it buys nothing a learner can feel.
courses.structureBody: Each lesson pairs a recording with the chapter it covers, the lab that proves it, and a short quiz. The video is an entry point, not a replacement.
courses.bilingualBody: Terminal recordings you can copy from, not screenshots. Every command shown is one you run yourself.
courses.certBody: Verifiable, and honest about what they are: a record that you finished something, not an industry certification.
home.continueDone: Path complete. Now build the production project.

labs.subtitle: Do the thing. Every lab has success criteria you verify yourself, and a challenge that removes the instructions.
labs.pairNote: Each lab comes in two tiers: guided, then the same goal without the steps.

labs.costBody: Run it in a dev environment and destroy it when you finish. Set a budget alarm first.
labs.readyToTry: Ready to try it without help?

seo.homeTitle: EgyKode — Open-Source Cloud & DevOps Learning Platform
seo.homeDescription: Learn Cloud and DevOps free and in the open: structured chapters, hands-on labs with a challenge mode, ordered roadmaps, and real projects you deploy yourself.
seo.learnDescription: 47 chapters covering Linux, networking, Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, AWS, CI/CD, GitOps, observability, security and SRE — each one explained with commands you run, how it fails, and the trade-offs.
seo.questionsDescription: 215 Cloud and DevOps interview questions with answers, levelled from beginner to principal and linked to the chapter that teaches each one.
seo.roadmapsDescription: Ordered Cloud and DevOps learning paths — from Linux fundamentals to a production deployment. Every roadmap ends with a project you can actually run.
seo.labsDescription: Hands-on Cloud and DevOps labs with verification criteria, each paired with a challenge version that removes the instructions.
